'''Slagpile Jetty''' was a shipping and receiving dock in [[Black Sun territory]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the jetty was used by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate to move their shipments of illegal goods, weapons, and drugs, and as such had a heavy Black Sun presence much of the time.
